verdict.rationale: Marketing copy claims AI-powered categorization and real-time webhook event notifications for spend/expense events, implying near-real-time visibility, and org-structure API support suggests team-level breakdown. However, there is no direct evidence of an end-user dashboard showing spend by team, category, and merchant in real time — most evidence is developer/API-oriented rather than a founder-facing reporting view. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard/reporting screenshots or docs showing real-time merchant/category/team breakdowns for end users, independent corroboration of same-day visibility.
